# fflate

Pinned browser build of fflate 0.8.2 (MIT), bundled and minified by jsDelivr.
Source: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate/tree/v0.8.2
Downloaded from: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fflate@0.8.2/esm/browser.js/+esm

The build is checked in so disk loading does not depend on a third-party CDN
at runtime. The upstream license is in `fflate.LICENSE`.
